The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} is equipped in the {{Icon|axe}} slot and is used when chopping down trees for [[log]]s or when splitting wood at the [[chopping spot]].  The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} can be found in the [[graveyard]] [[trunk]] at the start of the game or can be purchased from the [[Blacksmith]].

Efficiency represents how much progress toward an operation each use of a tool provides. An efficiency of 100% would be full speed, 200% would be double speed, and 50% would be half speed. The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} is 70% efficient. 

Energy usage reflects how much energy each action consumes. The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} consumes {{Energy||1}} per swing.

Studying Rusty axe at the [[Study table]] will give you {{Techpoint|Red|10}}.
